meta.notes: Starter chronicle templates (iter-0c): day headers, scene card and one dry line per event type. Completed in iter-5 together with the renderer. Tone per MVP_SCOPE §12: no LLM, no embellishment — the readability test (T7) runs on exactly this output. Slots in {braces} are filled from the event log fields; unknown types fall back to the generic line.

events.examine_failed: {actor} squints at {target}, unsure what to make of it.
events.pickpocket_failed: {actor}'s hand drifts toward {target}'s purse — {target} notices the movement.
events.fire_started: Flame takes to {location}. Smoke begins to rise.
events.smoke_rising: Smoke fills {location}; it is getting hard to see.
events.location_burned_out: {location} burns out. Nothing will be the same here.
events.watch_change: The watch changes at the guard room.
events.expectation_violation: {actor} checks on {target} — it is not where it should be.
